tests.name: test_default_template_import_normalizes_shapes_and_copies_static
tests.reason: The local Template V2 rollout is default-off and does not mutate database rows or static assets during startup.

tests.name: test_default_template_import_force_replaces_static_assets
tests.reason: Force-replacing bundled static assets would bypass the local default-off rollout boundary.

tests.name: test_default_template_import_removes_static_directory_removed_from_bundle
tests.reason: Startup deletion of static directories is outside the local Template V2 compatibility surface.

tests.name: test_default_template_import_updates_existing_database_row
tests.reason: Automatic mutation of existing Template V2 rows conflicts with the feature-gated local write policy.

tests.name: test_default_template_import_removes_stale_default_database_rows
tests.reason: Automatic removal of persisted defaults would change local data outside an explicit API write.

tests.name: test_default_template_import_removes_all_defaults_when_bundle_is_empty
tests.reason: An empty upstream bundle must not delete local Template V2 rows.

tests.name: test_bundled_general_template_json_matches_template_v2_shapes
tests.reason: The local rollout does not ship or initialize an upstream general default-template bundle.

tests.name: test_resolve_default_template_id_maps_public_name_to_json_id
tests.reason: Local Template V2 APIs use explicit allowlisted string identifiers and do not alias a public default-template name.

tests.name: test_resolve_default_template_id_rejects_paths
tests.reason: No local API resolves a user-supplied template identifier to a bundled filesystem path.

tests.name: test_async_tasks_routes_use_hyphenated_endpoint
tests.reason: The local API retains presentation-specific async generation routes under /api/v1/ppt/presentation and does not add the upstream generic /api/v1/async-tasks router.

tests.name: test_async_task_status_enum_uses_string_column
tests.reason: The generic async_tasks table and AsyncTaskStatus model are not introduced into the local migration chain.

tests.name: test_check_async_task_status_returns_task
tests.reason: Task status remains available through the existing presentation-specific status endpoint and response model.

tests.name: test_check_async_task_status_returns_404_for_missing_task
tests.reason: The upstream handler targets an API and persistence model that are intentionally absent locally.

tests.name: test_list_async_tasks_filters_and_orders_tasks
tests.reason: Adding a generic task listing query would expand the legacy API and database schema beyond Template V2 compatibility.

excludedApiContracts.reason: The legacy router already owns this method/path shape with PresentationLayoutModel; mounting the upstream Template V2 GET response there would change legacy API behavior.

portedContracts.sourceConcept: Default templates must not become active implicitly.
Async task status remains reachable through a stable versioned API.
Expose only Template V2 method/path pairs that do not replace the legacy template read contract.
